fields.description: Skyvue Altier is the final tower in Sobha’s Skyvue collection within Sobha Hartland II. Its angular architecture arranges one- and two-bedroom apartments around different skyline, community and sanctuary-facing orientations.

overview: Luxe and Premium variants differ in usable rooms and outdoor space. The larger two-bedroom Type E adds a study/store and a powder room; that additional room does not turn the advertised home into a three-bedroom apartment.
research.locationNote: In Sobha Hartland II, with marketed outlooks towards Downtown Dubai, the community and Ras Al Khor. View references are unit-specific; adjacency to the sanctuary does not provide private access to protected land.
research.priceNote: Sobha publishes AED 1.83m subject to inventory. Property Finder displays a lower current selection reference and a sold-out label; these different catalogue states do not confirm developer availability. Obtain a dated unit quotation.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder publishes 60% during construction and 40% at handover. JRE reports the more detailed split of 20% booking, 40% construction and 40% completion. The displayed stages are secondary reported terms; exact dates and fees require the developer’s offer.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder reports June 2030. This is a public portal estimate, not a verified contractual commitment; confirm the latest programme for the selected residence.
unresolved: No current developer inventory, signed payment schedule, parking allocation, service charges or binding handover date retrieved.
Website layout selections are not the full brochure range. Examples are individually identified; study/store, powder rooms and balcony areas are not extra bedrooms.
Brochure plans are indicative and may change. Images remain illustrative.
